scope: Screen the RealDWG-Web ecosystem for distinct public DXF, DWG, and 3D-consumer routes and refine the existing parity/3D plans without promoting support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of public project READMEs, package documentation, changelog, and current plan matrix
method.evidenceRule: Mutable project documentation and changelog entries establish documented route boundaries and candidate discovery only; an exact package/source pin plus a generated-control runtime receipt is required before admitting execution evidence.

evidence.topic: Public DXF reader versus DWG parser lineage
observed: RealDWG-Web documents a converter manager in which the built-in MIT AcDbNativeDxfConverter is registered for DXF by default.
DWG is not registered by default; the public @mlightcad/libredwg-converter wraps LibreDWG through a Web Worker and WebAssembly assets.
The DXF parser/model-projection path is a distinct candidate route; the DWG parser shares LibreDWG lineage and is not an independent DWG vote.
doesNotEstablish: that the current package release accepts every ASCII or binary DXF mode
feature-complete field, graph, owner, block, or payload preservation
an independent DWG implementation or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep the built-in DXF parser as an optional composed-check candidate. Treat the DWG converter only as a correlated LibreDWG-family integration/projection route. Pin exact source, package integrity, worker/WASM artifacts, runtime, options, and actual input mode before any run.

observed: The mutable changelog records milestones for AcDb3dSolid, SAB decoding/wireframes, ACDSDATA attachment to 3DSOLIDs, and ACIS body-transform application.
doesNotEstablish: which exact published artifact includes each milestone
valid closed analytic B-rep geometry, units, or conformance to source dimensions
evidence.planUse: At most, use as a route lead for the existing composed generated-control checkpoint. Record every source/entity/owner/carrier/database disposition and diagnostics separately; retain the existing independent semantic-evidence gate.

evidence.topic: Private proprietary parser is a separate, limited route
observed: The project labels @mlightcad/dwg-converter a private/commercial package distinct from the public LibreDWG converter.
Its documentation describes partial 3DSOLID extraction and partial SAB decoding, with no full B-rep tessellation and possible wireframe or bounding-box fallback.
doesNotEstablish: a general analytic-solid result or an independently run consumer result
evidence.planUse: Do not include it in open-source peer counts or ordinary plan actions. No trial, purchase, installation, or use is authorized or required by this research update.

nextActions: Keep RealDWG-Web in the optional comparator inventory and do not add it to the per-slice validation loop.

If its exact public packages and runtime are available at the composed checkpoint, test generated ASCII and binary DXF controls with source-to-database identity, owner/block, field, coordinate, unit, and diagnostic assertions.
Treat its DWG result as LibreDWG-lineage evidence; report AcDs/SAB carrier linkage separately from any geometry output.
Do not count wireframe, bounds fallback, successful import, or mutable changelog language as analytic B-rep support.
Leave J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
